hypothesis: Adding a Step 0 freshness check to /demerzel compound — comparing the newest evolution-log mtime against git activity in this repo and sibling repos under ~/source/repos/ — will let the cycle self-detect input staleness and fall back to a git-log + memory + sibling-git scan, eliminating Discussion #242's silent failure mode.

plan.description: Edit .claude/skills/demerzel-compound/SKILL.md to insert Step 0: read newest mtime of state/evolution/*.json; compare to `git log --since=<mtime>` for Demerzel and sibling repos (ix, hari, tars, ga); if any sibling shows new commits with no corresponding evolution entries within 7 days, emit a 'stale-state' warning and trigger the harvest fallback before continuing.
plan.success_criteria: A test run on a deliberately stalled state/evolution/ correctly emits the warning and produces non-trivial promotion candidates by reading git log and recent memories.
risks: Cross-repo path assumptions — sibling repos may not be at ~/source/repos on every machine
Performance — git log against 4 sibling repos may be slow; cache hashes between runs
Scope creep — keep Step 0 a check, not a replacement for harvest
